name: Taffy Tales
source:
In Taffy Tales, you will see the story of a regular guy with a new split personality disorder living in the town of Taffy, where almost every common citizen has an unprecedented dark side… 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/UberPie] Patreon[/url]]
